question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "contrite" in the sentence given below:

She was taken aback by his hurtful words, wondering why he would choose to speak so unkindly.
solution:
The correct answer is: **hurtful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contrite"** means feeling or expressing remorse or penitence; affected by guilt. (पश्चातापी)

 
 
• **Example: **He felt contrite after realizing the impact of his harsh words on his friend.
 
 
 
• **"Hurtful" **refers to causing distress or injury to someone’s feelings. (हानिकारक)
 
 
• **Example: **His hurtful comments left her feeling upset and unappreciated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'contrite' **is **'hurtful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **hurtful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aback **(चकित): By surprise or shock.

 
 
• **Example:** She was taken aback by the unexpected turn of events.
 
 
 
• **Unkindly **(अप्रिय ): In a harsh or unpleasant manner.
 
 
• **Example: **He spoke unkindly to his colleague, causing distress.
 
 
 
• **Wondering** (विचारणीय): Feeling curiosity or doubt.
 
 
• **Example:** She was wondering if she made the right decision.
